prompt_verbatim: Generate ONE complete isolated Ultraman Type C pixel-art sprite, side view facing right, between the two supplied animation poses. Keep head, torso, arms and pelvis at the same relative position and proportions as in reference 1. Change the leg pose to the intermediate angular position: FROM each hip, each entire red upper thigh goes diagonally LEFT AND DOWN about 45 degrees, so BOTH visible knees lie unmistakably left of and below the hips. Each lower leg bends farther left and down from its knee, and feet point left. This is a rearward swing of BOTH WHOLE THIGHS; it is NOT simply bending the calves behind vertical thighs. Keep each thigh naturally long, with exactly two anatomically connected legs, and preserve two tucked-back arms. Reference 2 is later where thighs are almost horizontal left. Match reference 3's exact silver/red suit and blue chest light. Render full character only on a transparent background, sharp cohesive 2D pixel art; no monster, objects, lettering, shadow, glow or cut limbs.
